name: PCB & inverter board repair
tagline: Board-level repair for inverter and smart ACs
summary: Repair or replacement of indoor and outdoor control boards, sensors and displays.
description: Modern inverter ACs rely on electronic boards to control the compressor, fans and sensors. Voltage fluctuations, moisture and age can damage them, causing error codes or a dead unit. We diagnose the fault, repair boards at component level where possible, or replace them with compatible boards.
duration: Same day for many faults; board repairs may take 1 – 3 days
suitable_for: Inverter and non-inverter split, cassette and VRF indoor units
includes: Sensor, display and remote receiver replacement
signs: Error code or blinking lights on the display
AC doesn't respond to the remote
Unit stops after a power fluctuation
Compressor won't start on an inverter AC

options.name: Board replacement
options.detail: When repair isn't possible or cost-effective

process.title: Read the fault
process.text: We read error codes and test sensors and wiring.

process.title: Board check
process.text: The PCB is tested to locate failed components.

process.title: Repair or replace
process.text: We repair at component level or fit a compatible board.

process.title: Test run
process.text: Full operation test across modes and speeds.

faqs.question: Is PCB repair cheaper than replacement?
faqs.answer: Usually, yes. Many faults are a few failed components, and repairing them costs much less than a new board.

faqs.question: How can I protect the PCB?
faqs.answer: A suitable stabiliser or voltage protector helps, especially in areas with frequent power fluctuations.
